info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: list reports every destination this deployment can forward to, each with the caller org's connection state: whether it is connected, whether it is enabled, whether a credential resolves right now, and the config fields the console renders for it.
get.description:
list reports every destination this deployment can forward to, each with the
caller org's connection state: whether it is connected, whether it is enabled,
whether a credential resolves right now, and the config fields the console
renders for it.

delete.summary: disconnect forgets a destination for the caller's org: every credential held in KMS, then the stored config.
delete.description:
disconnect forgets a destination for the caller's org: every credential held in
KMS, then the stored config. Idempotent, and it requires org admin.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description:
Platform is the destination to act on, from the path: ga4 | meta | tiktok |
linkedin | x | reddit | posthog | umami.

get.summary: get reports one destination's card for the caller's org — its config fields, its connection state, and whether a credential resolves right now.
get.description:
get reports one destination's card for the caller's org — its config fields,
its connection state, and whether a credential resolves right now. A platform
this deployment does not carry is not found.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description:
Platform is the destination to act on, from the path: ga4 | meta | tiktok |
linkedin | x | reddit | posthog | umami.

post.summary: test sends ONE synthetic pageview through the connected destination end to end and reports what the platform said.
post.description:
test sends ONE synthetic pageview through the connected destination end to end
and reports what the platform said. A send the platform refuses is reported as
data — {"ok": false, "error": …} at 200 — so the console shows the platform's
own words rather than an error about Hanzo. It requires org admin.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description:
Platform is the destination to act on, from the path: ga4 | meta | tiktok |
linkedin | x | reddit | posthog | umami.

disconnected.description: Disconnected is true when the credentials and the row are gone.

destinations.description: Destinations is one card per registered platform, in slug order.

error.description: Error is the platform's rejection, present only on a failed send.

message.description: Message is the platform's own note about the send, present only on success.

ok.description: OK is true when the platform accepted the synthetic event.

sent.description: Sent is how many events the platform accepted, present only on success.
